steps.content: [V. D. Satheesan] Vadasseri Damodaran Satheesan (born 31 May 1964) is an Indian politician, lawyer and statesman who is serving as the 13th Chief Minister of Keralam since May 2026. A member of the Indian National Congress, he has represented Paravur in the Kerala Legislative Assembly since 2001. In the 2026 Kerala Legislative Assembly election, he led the Congress-led UDF to a landslide victory, with the alliance securing 102 seats in the 140-member assembly and ending the CPI(M)-led LDF's decade-long rule in the state. | other articles: 2026 Kerala Legislative Assembly election, Satheesan ministry

V. D. Satheesan was elected as the 13th Chief Minister of Kerala in May 2026. He led the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF) to a significant victory in the Kerala Legislative Assembly elections, securing 102 out of 140 seats. FINAL: Chief Minister of Kerala.
